definitions.gloss: musical composition, piece of music, song, track
definitions.explanation: A completed piece of music, whether instrumental or vocal. A formal term that refers to any musical work as a finished composition.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{楽曲|がっきょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: They released a new piece of music.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦アルバム→アルバム：03831_arubamu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧10⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{楽曲|がっきょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{収録|しゅうろく}→収録：08378_shuuroku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This album contains a total of 10 tracks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{書|か}き{下|お}ろされた{楽曲|がっきょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{後|のち}→後：03545_nochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{大|おお}ヒット⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A piece of music written specifically for the film later became a big hit.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{楽|がく} (music) + ⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧ (tune, piece). Both elements relate to music.

USAGE:
{楽曲|がっきょく} is more formal than ⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧ (song, tune) and is commonly used in the music industry, journalism, and formal descriptions of music. In casual conversation, ⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧ alone is more natural. {楽曲|がっきょく} emphasizes the work as a composed piece of music.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {楽曲|がっきょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{制作|せいさく}する→制作する：25535_seisakusuru⟧: to produce a piece of music
- {楽曲|がっきょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提供|ていきょう}する→提供する：21736_teikyousuru⟧: to provide a song (to an artist)
- {楽曲|がっきょく}⟦{配信|はいしん}→配信：04898_haishin⟧: music distribution/streaming
- ⟦オリジナル→オリジナル：10829_orijinaru⟧{楽曲|がっきょく}: original composition
- ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧{楽曲|がっきょく}: popular song/track

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧: song, tune (general, casual)
- ⟦{歌|うた}→歌：02179_uta⟧: song (specifically vocal music, everyday)
